text: An unposted draft listed a replacement balance of 70 for amber10 and a debit of 9 for birch11. That entire draft was withdrawn before any posting. The approved replacement record set amber10 to 17. The delivery seal for batch 2 was linen-star.

birch11 was credited 6. A forecast suggested a future amber10 balance of 40; it was a forecast only and was not posted. ticket-s02 was transferred to birch11, effective before this batch ended. The delivery seal for batch 3 was violet-gate.
The opening posting set amber10 to 10. The opening posting set birch11 to 20. ticket-s02 belonged to amber10 at the end of this batch. The delivery seal for batch 1 was copper-leaf.
